retrieval_history: For Narnhofer et al., an earlier direct browser open of the arXiv PDF returned an internal error. An alternate full arXiv HTML copy was opened and the complete Proposition 3.5 proof inspected; the canonical PDF URL subsequently passed this full-text fetch check. No source was dropped or treated as unavailable. A separate 2026 publisher abstract lead (DOI 10.1016/j.cnsns.2026.110801) reports conformal inverse-identification coverage under exchangeability and conditional-stability hypotheses, but the full text/proof was not retrieved. It is a status lead only, omitted from selected full-text evidence, and retained for owner review. Retrieval history for the abstract-only status lead: official ScienceDirect page returned 403; two official PDF endpoint variants returned cache misses; EurekaMag metadata returned only the abstract; exact author/title/DOI searches found no full-text copy. The source is not used to support the formulation and remains owner-escalated.
